description: This file exports a function `getMockProducts` which returns an array of sample product objects, each containing details such as id, name, category, description, image_url, price, weightOrQuality, discount information, and availability (instant delivery). It serves as a mock data provider for a grocery shopping frontend application.

methods.name: getMockProducts()
methods.description: Returns a list of sample products with details including name, price, weight/quality, and discount info.
